proposals.evidence: DEDR4004 contains the whole ripe-fruit family, including Telugu paṇḍu and Tulu parndů, as well as Kannada paṇ/paṇṇu. Homepage discovery also finds Kannada haṇ/haṇṇu explicitly cited to DEDR4004 in Uchida–Rajapurohit p.904. Belari haṇdɨ combines initial h with a nasal-stop fruit stem; the ṇd and final ɨ are preserved, not normalized to the Kannada form. The Sanskrit phala comparison does not establish a donor. The proposed link uses the whole DEDR article; inheritance versus local transmission remains subject to review. This is a comparative family proposal; inheritance versus local transmission in this survey lect remains subject to review.
